zh: Dragon Claw 现在能直接改数据导入的整条指标规则：新增、修改（条件列、取值列、类型、聚合方式、子指标等）或删除，确认卡会显示每条改了哪些字段，以及按最近一次导入算出的改前 / 改后值和命中行数；每次改动都有记录，可以一键回退，之后被别人改过的规则不会被覆盖。仅管理员可用。
对话里保存数据抓取脚本前会先弹确认卡，列出改了哪些字段。
修复对话里修改已有抓取脚本时会冲掉请求头、请求体和分页等配置的问题：现在只改你提到的字段，其余保持原样。
en: Dragon Claw can now edit whole metric rules on the data import page: add, change (condition column, value column, type, aggregation, sub-metrics and more) or delete them. The confirmation card shows which fields change and the before / after value and matched rows from the latest import; every change is logged and can be reverted, and rules edited by someone else afterwards are never overwritten. Admins only.
Saving a scraping script from chat now asks for confirmation first and lists the fields that change.
Fixed editing an existing scraping script from chat wiping its request headers, request body and pagination settings: only the fields you mention change now, everything else is kept.
